title: Release v1.0.2: let the automatic Play draft upload run; stop before Play Console publishing
context: Owner 2026-10-14: "Tag and release. Sign the update files. Stop before the Play store update." then clarified "Any automatic Google Play steps is fine. I mean opening Google Play Console and and publishing." Release run 38519373652 (tag v1.0.2 at cd7e3b1b) runs the play job after the release job because repo variable PLAY_UPLOAD is true and the google-play environment has no required reviewers; PLAY_RELEASE_STATUS is draft and the track defaults to alpha.
options: Leave PLAY_UPLOAD true and let the play job upload the 1.0.2 draft to the alpha track; do nothing in Play Console
Set PLAY_UPLOAD false before the release job finishes and restore it afterwards
Cancel run 38519373652 the moment the release job completes, before the play job uploads
option_reasons: The owner's clarification allows every automatic Play step; the job only uploads a draft, which publishes nothing
Changes repository configuration the owner's clarification shows is not wanted
Races a job the owner allows and would mark the run cancelled instead of success
outcome: Left PLAY_UPLOAD true and PLAY_RELEASE_STATUS draft untouched (checked 2026-10-14 06:0xZ, both unchanged since 2026-10-12). The release job publishes the GitHub release with SHA256SUMS.txt.sig and appcast.xml; the play job uploads a draft only. Nothing is opened or published in Play Console; that step stays with the owner.
